backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing e-commerce functionality including product management, shopping cart, user profiles, branding/homepage configuration, shop details, Stripe integration, and access control with admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: removing the AI description generation button from BulkProductUpload and auto-populating descriptions using selected templates without button clicks.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration, noting that BulkProductUpload has AI description generation removed and uses template selector with auto-copy functionality.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, defining design tokens for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and UI elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title 'Original Creations Hub' and root div mounting the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for marketplace, dashboard, basket, checkout, payment, and legal pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider with dynamic branding hook and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin component for configuring site branding including site name, logo, and favicon uploads with preview, progress tracking, and form validation using React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Bulk product upload component with template selector dropdown that auto-populates descriptions, auto-copy toggle for syncing fields (name, description, shape, category, price, inventory) across products, and individual image upload progress tracking without AI generation functionality.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: A dialog component for creating and editing description templates with name and content fields, using React hooks for state management and mutations for save operations.
Manages a list of description templates with CRUD operations, displaying templates in cards with edit/delete actions and an empty state for when no templates exist.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A footer component displaying site information, legal links (Terms & Privacy Policy), contact email from shop details, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: A settings form for customizing homepage hero section including motto, promotional text, and hero image upload with preview and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with header navigation (logo, basket with count badge, dashboard, login/logout), authentication handling via Internet Identity, and footer, using branding configuration for site name and logo.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: A card component displaying product image, name, shape, category, price, and an 'Add to Basket' button with loading state and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog component that displays detailed product information including image, shape, category, description, and price, with buttons to add to basket or buy now.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table component for managing products with inline editing capabilities for name, description, shape, category, price, and images, plus inventory count adjustment controls.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Disabled component that previously showed a profile setup modal after login; currently returns null.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Form component for configuring shop details including name, address, contact information, opening hours, and company tax details with validation.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Setup form component for configuring Stripe payment integration by entering secret key and allowed country codes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Hook that dynamically updates the document title and favicon based on branding configuration from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, identity storage, and authentication status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, products, cart items, Stripe configuration, branding, shop details, homepage config, and description templates. Each hook uses the actor from useActor and manages query/mutation state with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm terracotta and earthy color palette for light and dark modes, plus imports for Google Fonts (Crimson Pro and Inter) for an artisan aesthetic.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that displays cart items or a single "Buy Now" product, calculates totals, and creates a Stripe checkout session to redirect users to payment. Handles empty cart state and clears session storage after checkout.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with authentication checks, Stripe setup flow, and tabbed interface for managing products, bulk uploads, Stripe settings, branding, shop details, homepage configuration, and description templates. Displays statistics cards for product count, inventory, and total value.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace page displaying featured, most viewed, best selling, and newest products with filtering by shape and category. Includes a hero section with configurable background and text, plus product detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page displaying an error message with options to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that clears the cart and Buy Now session storage, then displays a confirmation message with a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page displaying information collection, usage, sharing, payment processing, data security, user rights, cookies, children's privacy, and contact details in a card layout.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping basket page that displays cart items with quantity controls, removal functionality, price calculations, and checkout navigation using React Query hooks for cart management.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Static terms and conditions page covering introduction, products/services, pricing/payment, shipping, returns, intellectual property, liability, and contact information in a card layout.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended typography, container queries, animations, and custom font families (Inter and Crimson Pro).
project_state.json: Project state document tracking an artisan marketplace with bulk image upload, AI descriptions, Stripe integration, and known issues including image persistence failures and checkout flow problems.
